_comment: Single source of truth for the in-VM browser's reachable hosts. Read by src/config/webAllowlist.ts (renderer) and electron/main.cjs (main process) so the two enforcement points cannot drift apart. Search engines and the major vendor docs are included: a lab you cannot look things up from teaches a way of working nobody actually uses. Microsoft's portals (azure.com, entra.microsoft.com) and their sign-in hosts (microsoftonline.com, live.com) are listed so the 90-Day Challenge's Entra ID labs can be done in the in-VM browser.
